request.limits_note: limits are the recorded request budgets (dose budget per member, equal for all members); FN/FX missions use mission-specific dose budgets, others 100 kJ/m²

properties.vertex_rule: one vertex per leg end plus the origin; EDGE legs are straight chords u->v; a WAIT leg repeats the point with its end time; consecutive 1 s WAIT legs at one node are merged in waits[]

exposure_scope: centre model of this execution's own policy (RESULT result.per_member; dose includes incurred); this policy zeroes the radiant flux, so peak/dose are not physical exposure — see full_model_exposure

full_model_exposure.scope: offline full-policy centre-model check of this route (ablation dual-policy grade, independent_centre; not charged to the request); dose includes incurred

full_policy_check.source: ablation analysis/ROWS.csv full_policy_pass / full_failure_components (dual-policy grade, repetition 1)

source_records.role: outcome, full-policy grade and complete-request wall_s
dual-policy grade (full-model check of this route)

provenance.clock: complete-request wall_s recorded for the execution (external launch to authoritative publication) on the recorded native host
